headline: Waist-high fair-angle windswell — decent little log day.
today: Best of the NYC-area group today at 1.4-1.8ft, total to 2.3ft, though it's a fair angle on a short period. Cross wind hangs around all day so it'll be a touch textured — surf whenever it looks cleanest, morning likely your call. Log or fish.

daysToWatch.note: Similar size, 1.4-1.7ft, but NW cross-off all day keeps it groomed. Solid fun little log session.
Warning: SW onshore builds to 16mph by evening on a dropping, small swell. Early morning light wind only, then it's junked.
The one to watch: swell up to 4.1ft, total to 4.7ft, from a fair angle with N/NE offshore through morning and afternoon. Biggest and cleanest day by a mile — shortboard, rearrange plans.
